title: Normalized finite coefficient Verdier comparison predicate
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l distinct from its characteristic and a finite extension E of Q_l [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let X be a separated finite-type scheme over D.k with dimension at most a natural number d [def-weil-finite-type-morphism, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Define FiniteCoefficientVerdierComparison to be the conjunction of the normalized comparison predicates on the etale and pro-etale sites at every positive coefficient level n+1. The coefficient tower is O_E/varpi_E^(n+1) with its actual quotient maps. The etale dualizing objects and their maps are the counit-defined ones [lem-coef-finite-dualizing]; the pro-etale ones are obtained by comparison pullback [lem-weil-finite-duality-site-comparison]. At one site the predicate quantifies normalized scalar tensorators, prescribed duality pairings [lem-weil-duality-pairing] and ambient natural transformations S Hom(-,omega_n) -> Hom(S(-),omega_m). For a finite-Tor constructible input K [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], it requires preservation of that domain, invertibility of the comparison component, its evaluation and double-dual equations, and its identity and quotient cocycle equations. For every ordered interval [a,b] of K it additionally requires both comparison endpoints to have interval [-b-2d,-a]. The scalar unit, associators and tensorator normalization are fixed by the ordinary scalar adjunction and localized cochain unit; these are not free coherence choices. The pro-etale interval uses intrinsic realization followed by the published HasProEtaleTorAmplitude predicate. This definition only packages these requirements; it does not assert their existence. The existing helper definitions and instances are relocated verbatim with it.

def FiniteCoefficientVerdierComparison
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (d : ℕ) (X : Scheme.{u})
    (_hd : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] : Prop
